findings.title: Billing empty state is a bare string
findings.detail: A new account sees the literal text No invoices with no illustration, no explanation of when the first invoice appears, and no primary action.
findings.recommendation: Add an empty state with cause, expectation and a primary action.

findings.title: Invoice table has no loading state
findings.detail: The table renders an empty tbody while the fetch is in flight, so a slow network looks identical to an account with no invoices.
findings.recommendation: Render skeleton rows while the invoice query is pending.

findings.title: Plan block and invoice history compete for the same visual weight
findings.detail: Both sections use the same heading size and card treatment, so nothing signals that the plan is the primary object on the screen.
findings.recommendation: Promote the plan block to a full-width header and demote invoice history to a table under it.

findings.title: Failed card charge surfaces as a raw API string
findings.detail: The error branch prints the gateway message verbatim, including the provider code, with no recovery action.
findings.recommendation: Map gateway codes to human sentences and offer an update-card action inline.

findings.title: Avatar upload control is unreachable by keyboard
findings.detail: The upload trigger is a div with a click handler, so it takes no focus and announces nothing to a screen reader.
findings.recommendation: Replace the div with a button wrapping a visually hidden file input and label it.

findings.title: Profile copy uses passive voice throughout
findings.detail: Field help text reads Your display name will be shown to other members rather than naming who sees what.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite help text in active voice and second person.

findings.title: Form fields sit at a density that wastes the viewport
findings.detail: Every field is spaced for touch on a screen that is desktop-first, so the form runs to two scrolls for six inputs.
findings.recommendation: Tighten vertical rhythm at the desktop breakpoint only.

findings.title: Save button gives no indication that a save happened
findings.detail: The mutation succeeds silently. Nothing changes on screen, so the user presses Save again.
findings.recommendation: Move the button into a saving then saved state and hold the confirmation for two seconds.

findings.title: Step transitions cut with no motion
findings.detail: Each step swaps the whole panel instantly, so the user loses the sense of moving forward through a sequence.
findings.recommendation: Slide the outgoing and incoming panels along the axis of progress at 180ms.

findings.title: Welcome hero overflows below 380px
findings.detail: The two-column hero never collapses, so the primary action is pushed off-screen on a small phone.
findings.recommendation: Collapse the hero to a single column under 480px and keep the action above the fold.

findings.title: First-run moment is functional but unmemorable
findings.detail: The screen states the product name and a subtitle. There is no moment that rewards arriving.
findings.recommendation: Give the first paint one deliberate flourish that resolves within a second.

findings.title: Primary button style differs from the rest of the product
findings.detail: The onboarding CTA uses its own radius and weight, so onboarding reads as a different application.
findings.recommendation: Use the shared primary button token and delete the local override.
